† [נִקּוּד] n.[m.] perhaps what is crumbled or easily crumbles, crumb (cf. נְקֻדָּה);—only pl.
1. crumbs: כֹּל לֶחֶם צֵידָם יָבֵשׁ֭ הָיָה נִקֻּדִים Jos 9:5 all the bread of their provision was dry (and) become crumbs (𝔊 βεβρωμένος[οι]; 𝔙 in frusta comminuti), cf. יָבֵשׁ וְהָיָה נ׳ v 12 (v. Di Benn).
2. appar. a kind of (hard) biscuit or cake 1 K 14:3 (brought as present; + לֶחֶם, etc.).
